deities.name: Aten Ra

deities.lore: Aten-Ra is the living office humans later remembered as Ra, Aten, and divine kingship fused together. He does not wear pharaoh imagery — pharaohs copied his Gate-born crown, collar, and solar hand-rays after dreaming of the Sun-Scale Gate. On the battlefield he anchors Ma’at itself, forcing chaos to declare its weight before it can pass.
deities.personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
deities.visualDescription: Colossal living solar judge with readable divine anatomy, an Aten sun-disc crown radiating subtle hand-like rays, electrum wesekh collar fused into chest armor, Ma’at feather balance seams, white-gold noon aura, black-lapis shadow insets, and pylon-shaped shield forearms.
